# Clubhouse-API

A full API for Clubhouse.

## Description

Clubhouse-API is a full API for Clubhouse. It provides a simple way to access the Clubhouse API. It is a wrapper around the Clubhouse API and provides a simple way to access the API.

## Installation

- Clone this repository
- Run `npm install`
- Create profile.json file in root directory
- Add your profile information to profile.json
- Run `npm start`
